summary:
Iteration 53 — REMAINDER click-everything sweep (post iter52). Logged in as owner, went HomePicker → Contractor → Siding dashboard, created a sandbox estimate via new-estimate-btn (id 515e380f, EST-347637), walked Dashboard search/filters, duplicated it (id 7da14143 EST-891353), clicked duplicate estimate-row, clicked delete-<id> in EN and again in ES, opened the QuoteModal on the sandbox and walked send-lang-picker (en/es), download-pdf-btn (real download: EST-347637.pdf), and quote-close-btn, changed waste-pct + clicked rederive-now-btn + walked fascia-width-select on the sandbox, opened Catalog (walked 5 tabs), Team (toggled quote-footer-toggle), BrandingAdmin (no-token render), share pages /m/ and /r/ with ?lang=en & ?lang=es, ISS dashboard, AI Measure modal on the siding demo estimate (open+close, no destructive click). Re-verified the ES-labelled Hover restore modal on 5d7b7f67 (RESTAURAR LÍNEAS HOVER / IMPRIMIR / CANCELAR — all Spanish now, iter52 regression fix holds). Confirmed the '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning no longer fires from SettingsRow (0 occurrences over the full run).

ZERO pageerror / ReferenceError / TypeError captured across the whole sweep (only benign 401/404/409 XHR noise from initial protected endpoints). All matrix cells listed below PASSed except one UI regression noted under frontend_issues: the Dashboard delete flow does not actually delete after clicking delete-<id> then delete-guard-confirm — both the sandbox and its duplicate remained in the estimates list even though the script reported the confirm click succeeded. I had to delete them via DELETE /api/estimates/{id} to clean up (both returned 200 soft_deleted:true), so backend DELETE is fine; the UI wiring / delete-guard-confirm handler is where the break is.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid=delete-<estId>] does open (or at least dispatches) the delete-guard-dialog, but the subsequent [data-testid=delete-guard-confirm] click does not actually delete the row — both the sandbox (515e380f/EST-347637) and its duplicate (7da14143/EST-891353) were still present in GET /api/estimates?kind=siding after the UI delete succeeded in the script (no exception). Backend DELETE /api/estimates/{id} works fine (curl returned 200 soft_deleted:true). Suggests the confirm button either isn't wired to the delete handler in this state, is blocked by a warning we didn't dismiss, or the dialog rendered off-screen and the .click(force=True) hit a stale element. Repro cheaply by running the same flow on any freshly-created sandbox.

regressions_verified_fixed: iter52 fix — Hover restore modal ES labels: [data-testid=hover-restore-btn]='Restaurar líneas HOVER', [data-testid=hover-print-btn]='Imprimir', [data-testid=hover-cancel-btn]='Cancelar'. PASS in ES on the siding demo estimate 5d7b7f67.
iter52 fix — <span> cannot be a child of <option> hydration warning: 0 occurrences across the full sweep (walked SettingsRow waste + selects on the sandbox estimate). PASS.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the Dashboard delete flow. The delete-<id> button opens the delete-guard-dialog, but clicking delete-guard-confirm on a freshly-created sandbox does NOT actually issue the DELETE /api/estimates/{id} — the estimate stays in the list. Verified backend endpoint works via curl DELETE (200 soft_deleted:true). Likely candidates: (a) the confirm handler runs before delConfirm.id is set; (b) the dialog is closing before the click registers; (c) a warning-required flag is blocking without a visible prompt. Reproduce by clicking new-estimate-btn, then delete-<id> immediately.

MEDIUM: Consider adding a `[data-testid=material-list-share-copy-btn]` and `[data-testid=accuracy-share-copy-btn]` to the LP Material List panel and Tape Check panel so future sweeps can walk the freeze-and-share flow without inspecting API objects.
LOW: Add data-testid to blueprint-measure-btn and photo-measure-btn so future sweeps can walk them once they render (they weren't detectable on the siding demo estimate).
critical_code_review_comments: Delete flow lives in Dashboard.jsx around lines 540-608; the doDelete(delConfirm.id) call chain should be checked — either delConfirm state is being reset before the AlertDialogAction fires, or the .btn-danger action is only closing the dialog without awaiting the DELETE. This is the only real regression surfaced by iter53.

share tokens are not seeded on the LP demo fixture — makes /m/ and /r/ live-render coverage impossible without freezing (which is destructive). Consider seeding a read-only fixture with pre-minted tokens for future click sweeps.
AI-generated PDF path is confirmed working end-to-end (real download of EST-347637.pdf via download-pdf-btn) — printTakeoff scoping and _lang fixes remain green.

Sandbox creation via new-estimate-btn immediately routes to /estimate/<id> without letting the caller name the customer up front — Dashboard listing shows 'Sin nombre' rows for these which is confusing during live demo; consider defaulting customer_name to something like 'Untitled draft' or nudging the user with a focus on the customer field.

rca of the issue: Dashboard delete UI: clicking delete-<id> then delete-guard-confirm no longer removes the row. Backend DELETE /api/estimates/{id} works (200 soft_deleted:true via curl), so the break is in the React handler wiring (doDelete probably not being awaited or delConfirm state cleared prematurely). Reproduce: log in → new-estimate-btn → back to /dashboard/siding → click delete-<newId> → confirm. Row will still be present after the dialog closes. Mitigation for the demo: use backend DELETE via curl or a REST client if the owner needs to remove an accidental sandbox before the customer sees it.
